sdt.brc.android
Class BarcodeScanActivity

java.lang.Object
  Activity
      sdt.brc.android.BarcodeScanActivity

public class BarcodeScanActivity
extends Activity

Android Activity which preview the camera and reads barcodes from camera video stream. Each time new barcode is recognized the OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener.onActivityRecognitionResults callback will be called. The activity must be listed in the AndroidManifest.xml:

 <activity android:name="sdt.brc.android.BarcodeScanActivity"
             android:label="@string/app_name">
       <intent-filter>
           <category android:name="android.intent.category.EMBED" />
       </intent-filter>
 </activity>

To show activity from your application code call static method BarcodeScanActivity#ShowBarcodeScanActivityForResult which will generate required Intent and calls showActivityForResult method internally. If you pass a valid OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener callback instance into the method, then it's method OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener.onActivityRecognitionResults(java.util.List, YuvImage) will be called each time a new barcode object will be recognized. The callback interface implementation can decide either to close the BarcodeScanActivity by returning true from method OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener.onActivityRecognitionResults(java.util.List, YuvImage) or to continue scanning for next barcode symbol. If you pass null as callback then BarcodeScanActivity will return once one or more barcode symbols will be recognized. To obtain recognition results override onActivityResult() method which will be called by android runtime once the BarcodeScanActivity finish itself.

Field Detail

INTENT_EXTRA_RESULTS_COUNT

public static String INTENT_EXTRA_RESULTS_COUNT
The Intent output parameter key. The parameter contain number of successfully recognized barcodes.

INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_VALUE_

public static String INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_VALUE_
The Intent output parameter key prefix. The parameter contain string value of successfully recognized barcode located at position N For example, to access 4th barcode value call Intent.getExtras().getString(INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_VALUE_AS_STRING_ + 4); The total number of barcode results stored in the intent stored at INTENT_EXTRA_RESULTS_COUNT

INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_TYPE_NAME_

public static String INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_TYPE_NAME_
The Intent output parameter key prefix. The parameter contain bytes array of successfully recognized barcode located at position N For example, to access 4th barcode value call Intent.getExtras().getString(INTENT_EXTRA_RESULT_VALUE_AS_BYTES_ + 4); The total number of barcode results stored in the intent stored at INTENT_EXTRA_RESULTS_COUNT

showBarcodeScanActivityForResult

public static void showBarcodeScanActivityForResult(Activity parentActivity,
                                                    int requestCode,
                                                    String licenseKey,
                                                    int barcodeTypes,
                                                    boolean enableFlashlight,
                                                    boolean showScanArea,
                                                    OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener recognitionListener,
                                                    View overlayView)
The method creates intent and run the new ScannerBarcodeActivity. The activity must be listed in the AndroidManifest.xml:
<activity android:name="sdt.brc.android.BarcodeScanActivity" android:label="@string/app_name"> <intent-filter> <category android:name="android.intent.category.EMBED" /> </intent-filter> </activity>

Parameters:
parentActivity - parent activity.
requestCode - activity request code. This request code will be passed to startActivityForResult() internal call.
licenseKey - Valid SD-TOOLKIT Developer Key
barcodeTypes - flag indicating which barcode types to scan.By default barcodeTypes is set to BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_ALL_1D | BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_ALL_2D barcodeTypes can be one or combination of the following flags:
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODABAR
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODABAR
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODE128
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODE32
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODE39
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODE93
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_CODE11
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_EAN13
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_EAN8
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_EAN5
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_I2OF5
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_PATCH_CODE
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_POSTNET
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_PLUS2
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_PLUS5
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_UPCA
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_UPCB
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_INTELLIMAIL
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_DATAMATRIX
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_PDF417
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_QRCODE
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_ALL_1D
BarcodeReader.SDTBARCODE_ALL_2D
enableFlashlight - enable or disable camera flashlight during barcode scan
showScanArea - enable or disable active scan rectangle visualization over camera preview window
recognitionListener - OnBarcodeScanActivityRecognitionListener Interface implementation object.
overlayView - custom Overlay view which will be shown over the camera preview screen.

showBarcodeScanActivityForResult

public static void showBarcodeScanActivityForResult(Activity parentActivity,
                                                    int requestCode,
                                                    BarcodeScanActivityScanParameters params)
The method creates intent and run the new ScannerBarcodeActivity. The activity must be listed in the AndroidManifest.xml:
<activity android:name="sdt.brc.android.BarcodeScanActivity" android:label="@string/app_name"> <intent-filter> <category android:name="android.intent.category.EMBED" /> </intent-filter> </activity>

Parameters:
parentActivity - parent activity.
requestCode - activity request code. This request code will be passed to startActivityForResult() internal call.
params - obect of ScanParameters which contain recognition parameters
